artBrief: **French romance.** A glowing cafe on a riverside street at dusk, with a bridge and two empty cups in the foreground. Rose, amber, and deep blue color clusters.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. French romance. A glowing cafe on a riverside street at dusk, with a bridge and two empty cups in the foreground. Rose, amber, and deep blue color clusters. Strong cafe facade with warm glowing windows beside a blue river and small bridge. Two prominent cups in the foreground, dusk rose and amber reflections, inviting calm.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
